svg.title: malaria-amplicon-nf workflow overview
svg.desc: Overview from paired FASTQ files through DADA2, exact CIGAR calling, optional KELT QC and CD-HIT sensitivity clustering, participant-level input preparation, and independent DInEMITES and Dcifer analyses.
svg.text: Solid arrows show the main data flow. Dashed arrows mark optional, sensitivity, metadata, or reporting paths. DInEMITES and Dcifer are independent consumers of the same prepared analysis input.
